properties.description:
The tenth and last of the 2026-09-11 tool sweep's criterion-2 verdicts. `design_regions` is billed by its own description as the one orientation read that asks for no seed — *"call it at check-in"* — and could not be made to return: >300 s twice, >150 s again, wedging the shared daemon each time.

TWO CAUSES, found one after the other, each by the root-cause procedure and each with two or three of my own hypotheses measured and killed first.

**Layer 1 — every walk rebuilt the whole network.** `propagate_from`'s last act is an all-pairs betweenness over 4,176 nodes and 24,242 edges, on every call, to attach a centrality figure for ranking. `design_regions` walks once per Project and Component (109 seeds) and paid it 109 times. The measurement that found it: five consecutive calls with no write between came back 4705 / 4260 / 4227 / 4323 / 4284 ms — FLAT. A memo-able cost drops after the first call; a startup cost does not recur; flat-and-high means work redone every time. **never returned → 29.6 s.**

**Layer 2 — Anthony: "29.6s is slow".** The remainder was not 109 walks × a fair per-walk cost. The 108 walks made **4,502 node visits over 589 distinct nodes — 7.6× redundant**, because neighbouring seeds overlap and each walk started from nothing; at ~4 ms a visit that is 18.0 s of the 21.6 s spent walking. The per-visit cost was itself the target: `impact_neighbors` ran two fresh prefix scans of the adjacency column families for every node it reached, so a hub was re-read once per walk that touched it. One memoised scan of `CF_ADJ_OUT` replaced them. **29.6 s → 12.5 s**, and `propagate_from` ~250 ms → ~60 ms warm.

**WHAT THIS EPOCH IS NOT.** It is not a claim that `design_regions` is fast. 12.5 s for a call whose description says to make it at check-in is better than 29.6 and is still seconds, and whether that is acceptable is a judgement nobody has made.

**THE LESSON, and it is about the procedure rather than the code.** Five of the eight candidates across the two layers were mine and wrong, and each was killed by a measurement rather than by argument. The one that mattered most nearly went unmeasured: the first redundancy run reported a tidy 1.0× and was measuring nothing, because `propagate_from` summarises unless `full: true`. Step ⑤ of the root-cause skill — *read the RESULT, not that the call finished* — is the only reason the second layer was found at all.
properties.name: A walk does not recompute the whole network, nor re-read it once per hop
